mapper.select: SELECT pm.member_id, pm.user_id, su.real_name, pm.member_role FROM project_member pm JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = pm.user_id AND su.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE pm.member_role WHEN 'leader' THEN 1 WHEN 'advisor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, pm.member_id ASC
SELECT pm.project_id FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pm.project_id DESC

SELECT cp.project_id, cp.project_name, cp.team_name, cp.status, cp.completion_rate, cp.deadline, leader.real_name AS leader_name, cn.title AS notice_title FROM project_member pm JOIN competition_project cp ON cp.project_id = pm.project_id AND cp.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user leader ON leader.user_id = cp.leader_id AND leader.is_deleted = 0 JOIN competition_notice cn ON cn.notice_id = cp.notice_id AND cn.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY cp.project_id DESC
